findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plain text in the Lambda function's environment variables. These credentials are visible to anyone with describe permissions on the resource, and this represents a serious credential leak.
The Lambda function uses nodejs12.x runtime which is deprecated/end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving the function exposed to known vulnerabilities.
